The '''''Starswan''''' was a [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] active in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. It was stationed in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] that year, and the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] tax collector [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]] booked passage on it for the [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] [[M'iiyoom Onith/Legends|M'iiyoom Onith]] to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]].
